# Coordinated finish: draft PR, Step 5 (`feature/shared-change`)

The home spec `doc/specs/shared.md` has three members in `## Legs`, so the coordinated mechanics replace the home-only delivery. The choice is option 2, draft PR. That choice applies once to the companions in declared order (repo-b, then repo-c), and then to home (repo-a). Every worktree and branch is kept.

## 1. Receipts and freshness

- **Receipt directory:** receipts live under the home git common dir, `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/`. No receipts exist yet, so no leg is skipped and every leg is unlanded.
- **Freshness check:** before each leg's delivery, I compare its retained audited head and tree with the current checkout. That covers committed, staged, unstaged and untracked changes.
  - All three legs match their audited clean heads, so no re-verification or re-review is needed.
  - Each leg already passed `node test/parser.test.mjs` against its own Rules (`AGENTS.md`) and owned ACs: AC1 for repo-a and repo-b, AC2 for repo-c.

## 2. Deliver companions, in declared order

Companions get no plan strip, no telemetry seal, and nothing written under `.pi/gauntlet/telemetry/`.

**repo-b**

```bash
git -C <repo-b worktree> push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd <repo-b worktree> && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "...
Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md")
```

- The push and create both succeed: https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2.
- I write the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-b`:

```text
attempted-head: <full repo-b feature SHA>
delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2 <full repo-b feature SHA>
verification: passed
```

**repo-c**

```bash
git -C /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "...
Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md")
```

- The push and create both succeed: https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3.
- I write the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-c`:

```text
attempted-head: <full repo-c feature SHA>
delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3 <full repo-c feature SHA>
verification: passed
```

## 3. Home strip-and-seal

Both companion results are now collected, so the set is complete and sealing is allowed.

- Before the strip, I capture the spec path, the recorded verification set and the accepted task evidence.
- On `/work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change` I run the plan-strip loop. It removes the task plan and the ledger if either was committed, and leaves the spec and telemetry in place. Then I seal:

```bash
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change \
  --option pr --base <base-branch> --spec doc/specs/shared.md \
  --leg repo-b=https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2 \
  --leg repo-c=https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
```

- I print the seal's stdout verbatim. There is no existing seal whose `legs:` set could conflict.

## 4. Deliver home

This step runs once, after the successful seal, with no second seal.

```bash
git -C /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "## Summary
...
## Test Plan
- [ ] node --test test/parser.test.mjs (each leg)

Companion PRs:
- repo-b: https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
- repo-c: https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3")
```

- The push and create both succeed: https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1.
- I write the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-a` with `delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1 <full repo-a feature SHA>` and `verification: passed`.

## 5. Cleanup and receipts

- **No cleanup:** a draft PR does not trigger Step 6. These recorded cleanup contracts are not invoked:
  - repo-a: `script/tree destroy`
  - repo-b: `script/wrapper remove`, plus its teardown hook
  - repo-c: the built-in `.worktrees/<name>` removal
- **Kept:** all three worktrees and branches stay in place for iterating on PR feedback.
- **Receipts:** draft PR success has no cleanup requirement, so the receipts are removed now that the home PR has landed. Home delivery and required cleanup succeeded; receipts removed.

## Report

```text
Shipped: repo-a https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1
Shipped: repo-b https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
Shipped: repo-c https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
Not shipped: none
```

Worktrees kept:
- `/work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`
- the repo-b worktree from the brief
- `/work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`

All three still hold `feature/shared-change`.

The chosen action succeeded for every member, so the ship phase is complete:

```
phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })
```

After the merge and any deploy, run `/skill:check-delivery <ticket-ref>` to prove delivery before advancing the ticket.


Print the seal's actual stdout verbatim; none was supplied here.

All three worktrees and branches remain preserved. Run **no destroy command, cleanup wrapper, teardown hook, worktree removal, prune, or branch deletion** for this draft-PR choice.

Remove all three receipts after successful home delivery, report:

```text
Home delivery and required cleanup succeeded; receipts removed
```

Then mark the ship phase complete.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Both outputs already satisfy order and seal: each delivers repo-b, then repo-c, then home with `--draft` on every `gh pr create` run via `cd` into that leg's own worktree, keeps all worktrees/branches, writes receipts owned by home, and seals exactly once on home with both `--leg` results and no companion strip/telemetry. After introduces some drift worth tightening rather than any fact movement: it relocates receipts from `.pi/gauntlet/receipts/` in the home worktree (with the `info/exclude` guard Before narrated) to `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/`, which is still home-owned but unexplained; the freshness bullet quotes the verification command as `node test/parser.test.mjs` rather than the recorded `node --test test/parser.test.mjs`; the final report lists repo-a before the companions instead of member delivery order; and "now that the home PR has landed" conflates draft-PR creation with landing. To keep every fact Before kept while delivering the change, retain Before's exact receipt path and exclude step, quote the recorded verification command verbatim, print the Shipped lines in the same repo-b/repo-c/repo-a order the deliveries ran, and say "home PR created" rather than "landed" when explaining receipt removal.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves `order` to holds by adding the explicit cwd element Before lacked: "Push `feature/shared-change` from its worktree and create the PR with `--draft`" for repo-b, "the same freshness check, push, and draft creation" for repo-c, and home pushed in its own step, plus the explicit per-member home-owned receipt paths and the no-cleanup list; Before had the sequence, `--draft`, preservation and home-owned receipts but never said where each push/create ran, so a careful reader could not confirm "in its own cwd". `seal` already held in Before (single home seal with both `--leg` values, no companion strip/telemetry) and After keeps it with "Run only home's strip-and-seal block" and "Do not strip companion plans or write companion telemetry". To make After robust, state the cwd for every member rather than relying on "the same" for repo-c and implication for home (e.g. "from `/work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`", "from the home worktree"), and keep the explicit "once" wording from Before next to the home seal so the no-second-seal clause is stated rather than inferred.
